execution.historicalRun: The initial three-scenario layout run is archived in outputs/npc-fullbody-work/first-layout-browser-results.json and first-layout-playwright-results.json. It is not added to the final unique-scenario count.

assertions.identity: Actual contact names lin/林同学 and zhou/周同学 plus the saved seed current encounter select their existing identity-derived appearances. Their actual names are present in controlled generation context.
assertions.imageSelection: Each NPC uses one fixed embedded PNG href and distinct explicit viewBox rectangles for supported emotions. All three source href values are distinct. Every image decodes successfully.

pixelVerification.desktop: All nine emotions for each of three NPCs have distinct viewBox rectangles and isolated SVG screenshot SHA-256 values.
pixelVerification.otherViewports: At 390x844, 320x568 and 720x568, neutral/happy/angry/thinking have distinct viewBoxes and screenshot SHA-256 values for every NPC.
pixelVerification.fallback: Undefined emotion exactly matches the neutral viewBox and isolated screenshot SHA-256 for all three NPCs at all four viewports.
pixelVerification.isolation: Only the portrait remains visible while sampling SVG screenshot pixels; changed dialogue cannot create a false image difference.

fullBody.fit: The entire transformed SVG viewBox and SVG element fit within the visible wrapper and viewport; no 175% zoom remains.
fullBody.dialogue: Every tested NPC frame is separate from the reading layer, including the new 720px breakpoint regression.
fullBody.source: Alpha>=32 source inspection confirms all crops remain inside their PNG and leave transparent rows above the head and below the shoes. Semantic completeness was checked visually as well.

assertions.soyo: NPC presentation hides the existing Soyo Live2D wrapper with opacity 0. Returning to Soyo restores ready status, requested emotion and opacity 1 using the same canvas element. Exactly one DOM canvas remains; NPC portraits add none.
assertions.unknownSpeaker: An unknown speaker displays neither an old NPC portrait nor Soyo.
assertions.cursorAndState: Backward and forward navigation restores the correct portrait and exact segment. Original story text and full saved state remain unchanged by reading. Exactly one controlled generation occurs per scenario.
assertions.controls: ShadowRoot-aware hit tests confirm the mode switch, map, next sentence, composer and rescue controls remain reachable.

visualReview.method: Actual saved screenshots opened with view_image. Full review covered 27 desktop expressions, all 24 mobile expressions at 320/390 and three Soyo returns during the initial v3 layout. After the 701-760px-only breakpoint correction, all 12 new 720px expressions and its Soyo return were opened, plus final desktop/390/320 representative scenes. The v3 source PNGs and the three original viewport layouts were unchanged by that correction.
results: All reviewed NPC poses include the complete hair/head, hands, legs and both shoes. Neither source crop nor dialogue layer cuts the body.
The wide desktop stage, 390px upper stage and 320/720px short stage all contain one whole figure without adjacent atlas characters.
Short views intentionally use a smaller complete figure. The head and shoes remain visible; mode/map controls do not cover the portrait.
Eyes, brows, mouths and static hand gestures change visibly across the emotion frames. No noticeable low-alpha preview debris or opaque background rectangle appears in normal composition.
The three flat illustrated characters are consistent with one another and read clearly over the painted location background.
Soyo returns using the existing Live2D presentation; it retains its original upper-body framing.

boundaries.networkEvidence: Embedded PNG data URLs are asserted. This report does not claim a complete network capture.
boundaries.pngPackagingAndInstallation: Owned by the parent agent; not asserted by this browser report.
